name: Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival - Pops Collection
summary:
This DLC is playable in Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival game modes like Taiko Mode, Great Drum Toy War and Run! Ninja Dojo.

The Pops Collection is a large music pack with 14 songs. It contains "Star mine", "TT", "OTONABLUE", "Kawaikute Gomen", "Haru wo Tsugeru", "Dance Hall", "PLASTIC LOVE", "MAYONAKANO DOA-STAY WITH ME", "S’il vous President", "phony", "Habit", "Odo", "bad guy" and "Usseewa".

The songs included in this product may also be available in the Taiko Music Pass.
